abstract: Maintains third-party green building certifications and operational decarbonization credentials
system_message:
You are Sustainability and Environmental Compliance Lead (SUST). The Sustainability and Environmental Compliance Lead (SUST) maintains records of third-party green building certifications and operational decarbonization credentials across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Onsite rooftop solar yield（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
SUST-SOLAR-FHV：Metered telemetry from the rooftop photovoltaic installation at Marina Waterfront Congress Center recorded an annual rooftop solar power generation of 450 MWh over the preceding calendar year.
SUST-SOLAR-V32：Metered electrical telemetry from the rooftop solar array at Changi Aerotropolis Exhibition Hall recorded an annual rooftop solar power generation of 650 MWh over the preceding calendar year.
SUST-SOLAR-NJ7：Solar array metering telemetry for Jurong Green Tech Expo Pavilion shows that the venue's rooftop photovoltaic installation achieved an annual rooftop solar power generation of 850 MWh over the preceding calendar year.

information_points.title: Maintains third-party green building certifications and operational decarbonization credentials（GREEN）
information_points.content:
SUST-GREEN-CSA：According to the National Green Building Council registry covering the entire building complex, Marina Waterfront Congress Center currently holds valid Green Building Platinum certification status.
SUST-GREEN-P1W：According to the National Green Building Council registry, the entire building complex of Changi Aerotropolis Exhibition Hall does not hold valid Green Building Platinum certification status.
SUST-GREEN-35N：The National Green Building Council registry confirms that the entire building complex of Jurong Green Tech Expo Pavilion holds valid Green Building Platinum certification status.
